modalities.evidence: T1 scans were obtained in every session.
Behavioral data about the final exam is provided in the 'sourcedata' folder.

output.population: Data from 20 'student' and 5 'expert' participants; students were enrolled in an introduction to computer science course, experts underwent the final scan only.
output.summary: fMRI collected while students enrolled in an introduction to computer science course watched lecture videos across sessions and took a self-paced verbal final exam; experts were scanned once.
